title: Bring Up Operator-Authenticated Proof Review Surface
description: Operator lifecycle command that brings up the ADR 0015 staging proof-cockpit review surface behind an HTTP basic-authentication operator credential.
purpose: Let the accountable operator start the loopback staging-proof-cockpit service, front it with an operator-authenticated Caddy, and reach the human proof review, bulk acceptance, and signoff controls at /proof, prompting for the operator credential at invocation.
outputs: Running staging-proof-cockpit Compose service on loopback 127.0.0.1:18085
Console URL and credential guidance on standard output
sideEffects: Prompts for an operator username and password and hashes the password with the Caddy image
Writes a runtime Caddyfile containing the operator credential under .proof-review (gitignored, never committed)
Seeds the acceptance ledger Docker volume from the committed evidence corpus on first run only
Starts the staging-proof-cockpit Compose service and an ad-hoc operator-authenticated Caddy container
failureSemantics: Fails closed if Docker is unavailable, the staging Compose file is missing, or the credential is empty; a failed bring-up records no acceptance and starts no unauthenticated surface. This command does not itself accept or sign off anything and upgrades no readiness claim.
aiGuidance: Use this command to stand up the operator-authenticated proof review surface per ADR 0015. It requires an operator credential and enforces HTTP basic authentication in front of the loopback cockpit; do not remove the authentication gate or the cockpit write guard, and do not treat a running review surface as a staging, deployment, production, or product-UI readiness claim.
